text:
nina: heads up 1 1 saw weird invoice-preview skews after the new routing policy rolled at 03:10 UTC. some tenants show duplicate charge lines.

dan: ok can you dump an example?

nina: pasted one tenant's events (trimmed):
  nina: event A: request_id=rq_9a, model=rw-7b, emitted_by=primary, ts=1610000010
  nina: event B: request_id=rq_9a, model=rw-3b-fallback, emitted_by=fallback, ts=1610000011

ravi: so both events made it past the edge and into the ledger before our dedupe window collapsed them. current dedupe window=600ms. these were ~200ms apart.

ops-bot: alert: billing_preview_delta tenant_id=tenant-42 delta=+142%

dan: that's pretty big. two quick options: 1) widen dedupe window (easy) 2) stop fallback from emitting if primary succeeded (requires routing change)

nina: also thinking bigger: add a stable routing_attempt_id at edge. aggregator can do exact dedupe on that id, and console can surface attempts per request.

ravi: agree. adding id is best long-term. but it's an internal API change that touches the metering envelope. will need coordination with consumers and billing team.

dan: short-term patch: set `emit_on_fallback=false` in the routing config for v2. patch landed in canary. reduces duplicate noise but doesn't solve races where primary fails late.

finance-ops: ping 1 please make sure we annotate suppressed events in the invoice preview so finance can reconcile. a silent suppression would confuse customers.

nina: will add a dashboard metric: suppressed_events_count and suppressed_tokens. add a flag in preview UI that shows how many events were suppressed and the total token delta.

ravi: for the schema rollout plan (rough):
  - week 0: emit routing_attempt_id in a header/field for 5% of traffic (no consumer behavior change)
  - week 1-3: consumers opt-in to read routing_attempt_id and dedupe using exact-match, fallback to request_id where missing
  - week 4: enable aggregator-level dedupe on routing_attempt_id for all traffic, keep emit suppression as backup

dan: while rolling, we should add a telemetry contract doc with examples. sample event payload: 
  {
    "event_type": "charge_event",
    "request_id": "rq_9a",
    "routing_attempt_id": "ra_20260321_01",
    "parent_request_id": "session_f_123",
    "model_name": "rw-7b",
    "tokens": 58,
    "emitted_by": "primary",
    "timestamp": 1610000010
  }

ravi: small note: use snake_case for ease with our analytics pipeline; and please include emitted_by enum (primary|fallback|retry).

ops-bot: proc: create change-request billing-schema@groups; id=CHG-2026-081

nina: i'll owner the dashboard work. plan to add a temporary single-panel for canary tenants that shows: total_events, suppressed_events, duplicate_event_rate, token_delta.

dan: i'll patch routing to set emit_on_fallback=false for canary (config flag). i'll add a feature flag to revert quickly.

finance-ops: once canary is flipped please CC us and we will run a reconciliation with affected customers. also request that devs mark suppressed events clearly in the preview CSV export.

ravi: consumer checklist i'll publish in the internal spec: parse routing_attempt_id if present, dedupe on routing_attempt_id, fallback to request_id, unit tests for near-simultaneous emits, add logging when both primary+fallback emitted within 1s.

nina: timeline estimate: patch routing canary today, dashboard tile in 24h, schema PR to billing-schema in 48h, 5% canary for routing_attempt_id next Tue.

dan: rolling now -> patch PR 7829, deploying to canary at 16:32 UTC. feature-flag name: routing.emit_on_fallback

ops-bot: deployment: PR 7829 -> canary cluster succeeded at 16:35 UTC

finance-ops: got the note. we'll watch invoice previews and will intercept any large customer noise.

nina: thanks. will post metrics in 1h.

ravi: follow-ups: add docs for analytics on how suppressed events are surfaced to billing exports; update runbook incident steps if post-deploy delta >50%.

dan: cool. tagging @product-ops for visibility.

nina: end.
